biotools.summary: CamlTree is a user-friendly desktop software designed to simplify phylogenetic analysis of viral and mitochondrial genomes. It provides a streamlined workflow integrating gene concatenation, sequence alignment, and phylogenetic tree estimation using maximum-likelihood and Bayesian inference methods.
